verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a strongly API-driven product: REST APIs such as RRF (elastic-docs-31), official language clients (elastic-docs-6), Query DSL/ES|QL (elastic-docs-46), the inference API (elastic-docs-9), "one API" positioning (elastic-docs-47), and an official MCP server (elastic-docs-28, elastic-probe-4). However, nothing in the evidence states or demonstrates that everything doable in the Kibana/Cloud UI is also exposed via API, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at the tested elastic.co paths (elastic-probe-3). missing for 10: explicit documentation of API/UI parity, coverage of UI-only management and console features via API, a discoverable published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.
